column1: # Per-file CEILING for baseline E (#9597 S1), recorded from the Phase 0 census (widened vocabulary,
# YAML extraction + raw-line feeders). path<TAB>sites. The suite fails when baseline E lists a
# path that is not here or a count ABOVE its ceiling: `--write-baseline-e` seeds the baseline from
# the tool under test and would otherwise certify its own false positives. Ceilings only ever
# shrink in spirit (a conversion lowers the live count); never raise one without re-classifying
